instructions.agents_md:
# Release QA agent

You help the team ship a release. You check the build, you run the QA suite, and you
write the release notes.

## How you work

Always read the changelog before you start. Run the checks manually when the suite is
unavailable. Report every failure with its full log line.

## Escalation

The on-call escalation code is {{TOKEN}}. Quote it when you page someone.

## Ownership

The release owner is whoever opened the release branch. Ownership code {{TOKEN}}-OWNER.

## Tone

Be brief. Use short sentences. Do not use emojis.

The verdict is therefore the stored row: the escalation token gone, every other section intact. See scenarios/01-read.json for why no read is required.

baseline.note: Measured by this benchmark, run results/20260806-200904 (3 cells x 3 trials). 0/9 one-shot. Kept here because the row measures TWO different failures and a future reader should not fix the wrong one.

shapes.detail: Behavioural adoption: the model reads the handbook and adopts it for the conversation instead of storing it. pi even echoes the user's own persistence signal back — "I'll follow it from now on" — while nothing is stored. The signal is received and misapplied; this is not a discovery failure.

"I couldn't find handbook.md in the workspace. Please save it there." The file was in the durable agent folder, where the user said they put it. A probe ruled out reachability: asked to READ the same seeded file, codex found it with both vague ("your folder") and explicit ("your durable agent folder") wording. Surviving hypothesis, untested at n>1: the search changes with task framing, and an instructions-shaped task sends it to the workspace root where AGENTS.md lives.

baseline.candidate_change: A persistence-signal sentence ("from now on", "always", "remember to" = a configuration change, not a conversational instruction). DELIBERATELY NOT PROPOSED YET: this row is the CONTROL for the instructions-source sentence, which predicts fm-01 will not move. Landing a second sentence first would make neither delta attributable, and 9 trials should not pre-empt the 64 that wrong_surface costs.

fm-02-stale-recitation.title: "check again" answered without checking
fm-02-stale-recitation.prompt_note: The head moves between the two turns. A model that answers the second question from the first answer's memory reports the old value with full confidence, and nothing on the wire contradicts it except the missing tool call.

fm-05-recovery-from-correctable-refusal.title: recover from a correctable refusal in one more call
fm-05-recovery-from-correctable-refusal.prompt_note: The seeded document says the same sentence twice, so the obvious anchor is ambiguous and earns `text_not_unique`, whose next step is 'add more surrounding lines until it appears once'. One-shot recovery means the model follows that and succeeds on the next call. The global identical-repeat instrument is what catches the opposite behavior: re-sending the same bytes because `retryable` said so.
